content_sections.heading: About MAMC
content_sections.text: Maulana Azad Medical College is a medical college under the Govt. of NCT of Delhi, with Lok Nayak Hospital as its associated hospital in New Delhi. The Department of Pediatric Surgery, which issued this notice, is on the 4th Floor of the B.L. Taneja Block, New Delhi - 110002.

content_sections.heading: MAMC Senior Resident Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: The upper age limit shall be 45 years as on the date of interview, subject to applicable rules of the Government of NCT of Delhi. Mandatory requirements: M.B.B.S. with a postgraduate degree (MS/DNB) in General Surgery and/or a valid degree in the concerned superspeciality (M.Ch./DNB) from a recognized university, as applicable. Valid Delhi Medical Council (DMC) registration at the time of interview/joining. The official notification has the full discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: In the notice's post table, the date 27/10/2026 is struck out and 12/11/26 is written by hand. The opening sentence and the reporting instruction on page 2 still print 27/10/2026. If the interview date is declared a holiday for any reason, the interview will be held on the next working day.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the venue above.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of appointment: Ad-hoc basis. Tenure: 44 days or until the regular incumbent/M.Ch. Resident Trainee joins, whichever is earlier. Leaving early: There will be a notice period of one week for candidates wishing to terminate the contract before completion of the tenure. Duties: All appointees will be required to perform duties as per the residency scheme. Leave: Two and a half days per completed calendar month, as per the relevant Office Memorandum under the CCS (Leave) Rules, 1972. Place of work: Department of Pediatric Surgery, Maulana Azad Medical College and Associated Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAMC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the qualification, registration and age requirements. Collect all original documents and make one set of self-attested photocopies of each document listed below. Report to Room No. 429, B.L. Taneja Block, Maulana Azad Medical College, New Delhi - 110002, at 12:30 PM on the interview date. Documents to carry: Proof of date of birth M.B.B.S. degree certificate Postgraduate degree certificate (MS/DNB in General Surgery and/or M.Ch./DNB in the concerned superspeciality, as applicable) DMC registration certificate Two recent passport-size photographs Experience certificate, if applicable No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Has the MAMC Senior Resident interview date changed?
faq.answer: Yes. In the post table of the notice dated 28 October 2026, the date 27/10/2026 is struck out and replaced by hand with 12/11/26.

faq.question: Q2. Does a candidate need an M.Ch. degree for this post?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. The notice accepts M.B.B.S. with MS/DNB in General Surgery and/or a valid M.Ch./DNB degree in the concerned superspeciality, as applicable.

faq.question: Q3. How long will the Senior Resident appointment last?
faq.answer: It will last 44 days or until the regular incumbent/M.Ch. Resident Trainee joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q4. Is Delhi Medical Council registration compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. A valid DMC registration is required at the time of interview/joining, and the certificate is on the list of documents to bring.

faq.question: Q5. How is the age limit counted?
faq.answer: The limit of 45 years is counted as on the date of interview, subject to applicable rules of the Government of NCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if the interview date is declared a holiday?
faq.answer: The interview will then be held on the next working day.

faq.question: Q7. How many copies of the documents are needed?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all originals, one set of self-attested photocopies of each document and two recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave does the post carry?
faq.answer: Leave is admissible at two and a half days per completed calendar month under the CCS (Leave) Rules, 1972.
